summary: Registers image/tiff as a MIME media type so that TIFF (Tag Image File Format) images can be labeled correctly in email and other MIME-aware protocols. It refines the earlier registration given in RFC 1528 and replaces RFC 2302.

eli5.summary: When you mail a photo, the envelope needs a label saying what kind of picture it is. This document officially names the label for TIFF pictures so every mail program recognizes them.
